107151.500: Five hundred messages from the Isle of Nith. The fog is thick. The cave has been found. The ritual is still happening.
107151.1000: One thousand messages. Warpriest Valerius Kael only said it once. The thread has been saying it in action ever since.
107151.1500: Fifteen hundred messages. Brother Elias put a good word in with the chaplain. The thread has put fifteen hundred words in for itself.
107151.2000: Two thousand messages. The Isle of Nith is small. The thread is not.
107151.2500: Twenty-five hundred messages. Bereket Sisay's bow is drawn. His breathing is slow. Twenty-five hundred messages have landed precisely.
107151.3000: Three thousand messages. Nith M'aera was put down by Lord Cumeyr. Three thousand messages of the party making sure it stays down.
107151.3500: Thirty-five hundred messages. Ten parties of five, spread across the island. Only one of them is in this thread.
107151.4000: Four thousand messages. The fog rolled over the boat and into every subsequent post. It remains atmospheric.
107151.4500: Forty-five hundred messages. Heron pressed his hand to Waldemar's shoulder and promised safety. The thread documents whether that promise held.
107151.5000: Five thousand messages! The cave entrance was found under the foliage. Elias looked genuinely surprised. The milestone is less surprising — this group was always going to reach it.
107151.5500: Fifty-five hundred messages. The world of Theria runs on the grace of The Seven. This thread runs on something similar.
107151.6000: Six thousand messages. The church requisitioned the mission. The party volunteered. Waldemar was told this was a bad idea. The thread covers what happened next.
107151.6500: Sixty-five hundred messages. House Valor sent Elias to earn glory. Elias sent the party ahead. The thread documents the results.
107151.7000: Seven thousand messages. Bereket counted his torches before entering the cave. The thread counted seven thousand posts.
107151.7500: Seventy-five hundred messages. Heron doesn't like caves. Heron has been in a lot of caves. The thread has been there for each one.
107151.8000: Eight thousand messages. The Divine Twins — burning sun, crescent moon — watch over this campaign. Their symbol means something different to each character.
107151.8500: Eighty-five hundred messages. Ali's fan-fighting style is the kind of thing that makes enemies pause. Then the fans move. The thread documents what happens after that.
107151.9000: Nine thousand messages. Nith M'aera was slain right here, on this island. The party has been standing on that history for nine thousand messages.
107151.9500: Ninety-five hundred messages. The morning fog on the boat, the shore of Nith, the hardened path through the forest — every step documented here.
107151.10000: Ten thousand messages! Elias pulls out the owl trinket and stares at it. The milestone would be a good place to signal. He agrees.
107151.10500: Ten thousand five hundred messages. Waldemar's deep voice is suited to both combat and to the kind of dry commentary this party generates.
107151.11000: Eleven thousand messages. The cultists who would resurrect Nith M'aera have been documented, encountered, and opposed. The thread documents the opposition.
107151.11500: Eleven thousand five hundred messages. Brother Elias promised a good word with the chaplain. By now he owes the party an entire recommendation letter.
107151.12000: Twelve thousand messages. The Isle of Nith remembers every party that walked its shore. This thread remembers this one.
107151.12500: Twelve thousand five hundred messages. Theria is not Golarion. Its gods, history, and geography are its own. This thread is part of that distinction.
107151.13000: Thirteen thousand messages. The burning sun rises. The crescent moon follows. The thread follows the campaign.
107151.13500: Thirteen thousand five hundred messages. The cave system on the Isle of Nith is extensive. So is this thread.
107151.14000: Fourteen thousand messages. Svir's contribution to the group has been documented alongside every other post. The thread holds space for everyone.
107151.14500: Fourteen thousand five hundred messages. Warpriest Kael said it once: fall in. The party has been falling in ever since.
107151.15000: Fifteen thousand messages — from the fog-soaked deck to the cultist cave, every step in Theria has been recorded with care.
107151.15500: Fifteen thousand five hundred messages. Heron leads the way with a torch and a shield. The thread lights the way with fifteen thousand five hundred posts.
107151.16000: Sixteen thousand messages. The school of the Tempest trained Bereket for the arena. The cave trained him for something less structured. The thread covers both.
107151.16500: Sixteen thousand five hundred messages. Elias found the right hole in the rock and nearly couldn't believe it. Sixteen thousand five hundred messages later, neither can we.
107151.17000: Seventeen thousand messages. The Divine Twins bestow their grace on the righteous. The thread bestows milestones on the persistent.
107151.17500: Seventeen thousand five hundred messages. The ritual in the cave is ongoing. The thread's count is ongoing. One of them is going to finish first.
107151.18000: Eighteen thousand messages. A squad of five volunteers — improbably assembled, improbably effective — has been writing this story together.
107151.18500: Eighteen thousand five hundred messages. Ali passed Heron a torch. The thread passed eighteen thousand five hundred posts.
107151.19000: Nineteen thousand messages. Nith M'aera sleeps in the deep rock of its island grave. The thread is very much awake.
107151.19500: Nineteen thousand five hundred messages. House Valor may record Elias's deeds. This thread already has.
107151.20000: Twenty thousand messages! The messenger bird token was supposed to be used only for critical news. Twenty thousand is critical enough.
107151.20500: Twenty thousand five hundred messages. Lord Cumeyr put the beast down with power and purpose. This party approaches every challenge with the same.
107151.21000: Twenty-one thousand messages. The church of The Seven watches the Isle of Nith. This thread watches the campaign.
107151.21500: Twenty-one thousand five hundred messages. Bereket breathes out through his nose before speaking. The thread exhales at each milestone.
107151.22000: Twenty-two thousand messages. The fog hasn't lifted from the Isle of Nith. The thread has not lifted from the campaign.
107151.22500: Twenty-two thousand five hundred messages. Heron adjusts his shield. Waldemar adjusts his stance. The thread adjusts its count.
107151.23000: Twenty-three thousand messages. The cultists chose a very inconvenient island for their ritual. The party chose this thread for their documentation. Both choices were significant.
107151.23500: Twenty-three thousand five hundred messages. Elias scans the forest one final time. The milestone is at the treeline.
107151.24000: Twenty-four thousand messages. The Isle of Nith is small. The story told on it is not.
107151.24500: Twenty-four thousand five hundred messages. Nith M'aera will not rise today. The milestone will.
107151.25000: Twenty-five thousand messages — the morning fog, the shore, the hardened path, the cave, the ritual, the fight. All of Theria is in this thread. All twenty-five thousand posts of it.
